labels.org.opencontainers.image.description: Jackett works as a proxy server: it translates queries from apps (Sonarr, SickRage, CouchPotato, Mylar, etc) into tracker-site-specific http queries, parses the html response, then sends results back to the requesting software.
labels.org.opencontainers.image.title: Jackett

dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-alpine:3.24

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG JACKETT_RELEASE
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thelamer"

# environment settings
ENV XDG_DATA_HOME="/config" \
  XDG_CONFIG_HOME="/config" \
  TMPDIR=/run/jackett-temp

RUN \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  apk --no-cache add \
    icu-data-full \
    icu-libs && \
  echo "**** install jackett ****" && \
  mkdir -p \
    /app/Jackett && \
  if [ -z ${JACKETT_RELEASE+x} ]; then \
    JACKETT_RELEASE=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/Jackett/Jackett/releases/latest" \
    | jq -r .tag_name); \
  fi && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/jacket.tar.gz -L \
    "https://github.com/Jackett/Jackett/releases/download/${JACKETT_RELEASE}/Jackett.Binaries.LinuxMuslAMDx64.tar.gz" && \
  tar xf \
    /tmp/jacket.tar.gz -C \
    /app/Jackett --strip-components=1 && \
  echo "**** fix for host id mapping error ****" && \
  chown -R root:root /app/Jackett && \
  echo "**** save docker image version ****" && \
  echo "${VERSION}" > /etc/docker-image && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/*

# add local files
COPY root/ /

# ports and volumes
VOLUME /config

EXPOSE 9117

units.name: init-jackett-config
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

mkdir -p /run/jackett-temp

if [[ -z ${LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER} ]]; then
    if [[ "${AUTO_UPDATE,,}" == "true" ]]; then
        lsiown -R abc:abc \
            /app/Jackett
    fi

    # permissions
    lsiown -R abc:abc \
        /config \
        /run/jackett-temp
fi

units.name: svc-jackett
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

if [[ "${AUTO_UPDATE,,}" == "true" ]] && [[ -z ${LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER} ]]; then
    COMMAND="/app/Jackett/jackett_launcher.sh"
else
    COMMAND="/app/Jackett/jackett --NoUpdates"
fi


if [[ -z ${LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER} ]]; then
    exec \
        s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 -c "nc -z localhost 9117" \
            s6-setuidgid abc ${COMMAND} ${RUN_OPTS}
else
    exec \
        s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 -c "nc -z localhost 9117" \
            ${COMMAND} ${RUN_OPTS}
fi
